summary: Solid bash script and workflow. Implements three retention policies correctly with good error handling, validation, and set -euo pipefail. Least-privilege permissions, proper GitHub Actions output capture. Minor issues: output format couples script and workflow tightly (brittleness if changed); reason string accumulation uses complex CSV pattern; sorting logic repeated (keep-latest and max-total-size both build epoch-index pairs). Would ship but could refine for production robustness.
